brand.name: ApnaCircle
brand.tagline: Find your people. Explore your city.
brand.description: A safe, city-based local discovery and group meetup platform starting in Saharanpur.
home.heroTitle: Find your people. Explore your city.
home.heroLead: Discover verified local spots, join small public-venue group meetups, and build genuine real-world community — with privacy and safety built in before any social features unlock.
home.pillarPlacesBody: Curated cafes, parks, photography walks, and weekend spots in Saharanpur — written and checked by humans, never auto-published.
home.pillarMeetupsBody: Hosted by vetted local organisers in public venues. Exact meeting-spot notes are visible only to approved attendees.
home.pillarSafetyBody: No anonymous profile browsing, no phone number collection, instant mutual block, and human moderation before one-to-one connections unlock.
home.categoriesSubtitle: Browse local spots and group activity categories curated for Saharanpur.
home.peopleTeaserTitle: People directory unlocks after community safety gates
home.peopleTeaserBody: We launch with group meetups first. One-to-one member discovery unlocks in Saharanpur once 150+ members opt in and trained moderation backup is active.
cities.pageLead: We start carefully in Saharanpur so local guides, hosts, and moderation stay trustworthy before expanding.
cities.upcomingNote: Each city opens only after local hosts, verified places, and safety coverage gates are met.
city.peopleNoticeBody: Meet people through group meetups first. The members-only directory unlocks once {city} reaches 150 opted-in members with trained moderation coverage.
category.emptyTitle: No verified entries in this category yet
category.emptyBody: We only publish places after first-hand checks. Suggest a public spot in Saharanpur using our feedback form.
meetups.pageLead: Small, public-venue group outings hosted by vetted local organisers. No trekking, overnight trips, or home addresses.
meetups.emptyTitle: Host vetting & meetup calendar opening in Stage A
meetups.emptyBody: Group meetups open as soon as our Trust & Safety core (Phase 3) and initial Saharanpur host vetting (Phase 4) are complete.
places.pageLead: Human-checked public spots, cafes, parks, and photography locations across active cities.
people.teaserTitle: Member profiles are never visible when signed out
people.teaserBody: To protect member privacy and prevent scraping, profiles and photos are accessible only to verified 18+ signed-in members once the city directory unlocks.
people.teaserInterests: Early interest areas: Photography walks, Cafes, Cycling & walking, Tech & hobbies
about.pageLead: Built for real-world local belonging in Indian cities — meetups first, privacy by default, and safety before growth.
about.principle1Body: Public-venue group activities create natural context and lower risk before anyone opens the people directory.
about.principle2Body: No phone numbers collected in V1, no public profiles, no live location tracking, and opt-in consent for discovery and analytics.
about.principle3Body: Local recommendations are verified by real checks and community feedback rather than unverified generated text.
policy.draftBannerBody: This policy document is currently a draft awaiting legal counsel review and completion of owner entity/Grievance Officer placeholders before public launch.
policy.directoryLink: See all policy documents & safety resources
feedback.pageTitle: Send Feedback or Report a Correction
feedback.pageLead: Spot an outdated place detail, broken page, or have a suggestion for Saharanpur? Share it here.
feedback.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe what you observed or suggest (minimum 20 characters). Please do not include sensitive personal details.
feedback.replyEmailHint: Only if you want a follow-up reply. Never shown publicly.
feedback.successBody: Your note has been recorded (reference {id}). We review feedback regularly.
feedback.errorGeneric: Could not submit your feedback right now. Please try again.
feedback.errorRateLimit: Too many submissions from this network. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
feedback.errorTurnstile: Please complete the verification check before submitting.
feedback.safetyCalloutTitle: Need to report a safety concern?
feedback.safetyCalloutBody: For urgent safety issues or emergencies in India, call 112. Read our Safety Center and Grievance process for escalation paths.
footer.copyright: ApnaCircle (working title). English V1 build — language-ready architecture.

state.notFoundBody: The page you requested does not exist or may have moved.
meetups.unavailableBody: We could not load meetups just now. Please try again in a minute.
meetups.noResultsBody: Try another category or date, or check back soon.
meetups.detail.venueNote: Public venue in {locality}. The exact meeting spot is shared only with approved attendees.
meetups.detail.joinBody: You need an ApnaCircle member account (18+) and to acknowledge the safety guidance. Member sign-in opens with the invite-only alpha.
meetups.detail.safetyBody: Public venue only. Tell someone where you are going, and arrive and leave in daylight where possible. In an emergency call 112.
